caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical model consisting of several horizontally stacked layers and various structural components. The bottom section of the model is a red, boat-shaped base with a large yellow wheel, which has spokes and fills much of the side area. Above the base are two horizontal, perforated bands: a lower gray band and an upper green band, both supported by multiple vertical rods or pillars, which are colored in gray and red. The bands are separated with enough space to reveal further mechanical elements inside, including cylindrical and vertical rods, some of which are orange, yellow, and blue. On the topmost layer, there is a green oval object with an attached yellow rod, sitting across the green perforated band. The mechanical construction appears to use bolts or rivets to connect parts, and a weight or hook hangs down from the front center of the red base. The overall color palette includes shades of red, green, gray, yellow, orange, and blue, with moderate shading and detail used to depict the objects' dimensionality. The background is an even, light beige color, with no other objects present.
title: Model of a Side-Wheeler
